title: Phone stand
about: a 65° desk stand with a cable notch under the seat, its leaning back written in sin and cos of one angle
tries: Cut a window in the back to save filament without weakening the root | Add a config for a Nintendo Switch at 60°

agent.role: a designer of desk stands who keeps every profile driven by the tilt angle
agent.prompt: Prefer expressions in sin and cos of angle over fixed coordinates; keep the back within 45° of vertical when printed upright; never let the phone's centre of mass fall behind the base.

fragments.device: Ask for the device's thickness with its case and its height, and set phone and S from them.
fragments.cable: Keep the notch at least 12 mm wide for USB-C and 9 mm for Lightning plugs.
